title: Castle Run v2 | Stylised 3D Animation
description:
A stylised armoured heroine sprints through a medieval castle at sunset, sword in hand: out of the gatehouse, across the courtyard, along the wall walk and into the torch-lit great hall, where she claims the banner.

Rendered in code with three.js; the run cycle is locked to the ground so her feet never slide.

3D models (all licensed CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/):
- "Fantasy Girl" by loriserio - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fantasy-girl-1ca6d15fe2f34bd199252bf73d896e13
- "Medieval Pentagon Castle" by Sereib - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/medieval-pentagon-castle-aa352f61de1646209a36f634e6b6dc27
- "Stylized Sword" by Agata Wilczek - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/stylized-sword-28897cc3c47a452ebd5624c758b6dce4
- "Throne Room" by Uğur Yakışık - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/throne-room-247c37e6a9694ae891398911876f0c14
Sky: "Belfast Sunset (Pure Sky)" HDRI from Poly Haven (CC0).
Music and sound effects generated with ElevenLabs.
Models were rescaled, re-lit and animated for this video; materials of "Fantasy Girl" were converted to PBR. Courtyard cobbles, the hall's entrance wall, torch flames and the banner on its stand were added in code; the sword was re-proportioned to fit her grip.
